name: bench-dep-denied
description: Vendored benchmark fixture 'dependency' that the benchmark policy grants NOTHING. Its frames resolve to a real package name (so attribution does the same work it does for bench-dep) but every mediated call is denied, which is how scripts/bench/bench.mjs times the enforce-mode attribute -> evaluate -> throw path for surfaces whose ALLOWED form would be dominated by real I/O. Deliberately a separate package rather than a second entry point on bench-dep: a boolean grant like child_process cannot be both held and not held by one principal.
